note: Local IaC, Kubernetes, Docker and cloud config rules. Static only. A hit is a review lead.

rules.title: Public ACL on a bucket or object
rules.impact: The bucket is readable by anyone.
rules.fix: Use private ACL with a bucket policy or OAC.
rules.false_positive: A static site bucket can be public on purpose.

rules.title: Database is publicly accessible
rules.impact: The database listener is reachable from the internet.
rules.fix: Move it private and use a bastion or VPN.

rules.title: Encryption disabled
rules.impact: Data at rest is plain.
rules.fix: Enable encryption with a managed key.
rules.false_positive: A test bucket with no data.

rules.title: Object versioning disabled
rules.impact: Overwrite and delete are harder to recover.

rules.title: Access logging disabled
rules.impact: No access record for the resource.
rules.fix: Enable logging to a separate bucket.
rules.false_positive: Logging at the load balancer only.

rules.title: MFA delete disabled
rules.impact: A stolen key can delete versions.

rules.title: Wildcard IAM action or resource
rules.impact: The role can do more than it needs.

rules.title: Ingress open to 0.0.0.0/0
rules.impact: The port is reachable from anywhere.

rules.title: Public IP assigned
rules.impact: The instance has a direct internet address.
rules.fix: Use a private subnet and load balancer.

rules.title: Deletion protection disabled
rules.impact: A wrong apply can drop the database.

rules.title: Backup retention zero
rules.impact: No automated backup window.
rules.fix: Set a retention period and test restore.

rules.title: Multi-AZ disabled
rules.impact: A zone failure takes the database down.

rules.title: Final snapshot skipped
rules.impact: Destroy leaves no snapshot.

rules.title: Privileged container
rules.impact: The container can escape to the node.

rules.title: Privilege escalation allowed
rules.impact: A setuid binary can gain root.

rules.title: Runs as root
rules.impact: The process has root in the container.
rules.fix: Set runAsNonRoot and a non-zero user.
rules.false_positive: Images that need root to bind a port.

rules.title: Root filesystem is writable
rules.impact: An attacker can drop tools in the image.
rules.fix: Set readOnlyRootFilesystem and mount tmpfs where needed.
rules.false_positive: Apps that write to their own path.

rules.title: Host network
rules.impact: The pod shares the node network namespace.
rules.fix: Use a service unless the agent needs it.

rules.title: Host PID namespace
rules.impact: The pod sees node processes.

rules.title: hostPath volume
rules.impact: The pod reaches node files.

rules.title: Image uses latest
rules.impact: The deployed version changes silently.

rules.title: No resource limits
rules.impact: One pod can starve the node.

rules.title: Default namespace
rules.impact: Harder to scope policy and RBAC.

rules.title: NodePort service
rules.impact: The service is exposed on every node.
rules.fix: Prefer an ingress or LoadBalancer with policy.

rules.title: cluster-admin binding
rules.impact: The subject controls the whole cluster.

rules.title: Wildcard RBAC
rules.impact: The role can act on everything.
rules.fix: List the needed verbs and resources.

rules.title: Service account token auto-mounted
rules.impact: A pod compromise yields an API token.
rules.fix: Disable where the pod does not call the API.

rules.title: Privileged container
rules.impact: Container escape reaches the host.

rules.title: Docker socket mounted
rules.impact: The container controls the host daemon.
rules.fix: Mount read-only or use a socket proxy.

rules.title: latest tag
rules.impact: The build changes silently.

rules.title: Host network mode
rules.impact: The container shares the host network.
rules.fix: Use a bridge network and publish ports.

rules.title: Secret in build arg or env
rules.impact: The value stays in the image layer.
rules.fix: Use BuildKit secret mounts or runtime env.

rules.title: Public bucket ACL
rules.impact: The bucket is readable by anyone.
rules.fix: Use a private ACL and bucket policy.

rules.title: Publicly accessible database
rules.impact: The database is internet reachable.

rules.title: Ingress 0.0.0.0/0
rules.impact: The port is open to the world.

rules.title: DeletionPolicy Delete
rules.impact: Stack delete removes the resource.
